# Third-party sources

Everything in `third-party/` belongs to its creators. It was collected by the project owner as mood reference and arrived in the design system's `assets/INSPIRATION` and as attachments on 2026-10-29. **No rights are granted**; nothing here ships.

## Saved result pages (PP-REF-SRC-001…003)
Google Images result pages saved as `.htm`. Each points at one image on a third-party site:

| Id | File | Site | Image URL (from the page's og:image) |
|---|---|---|---|
| PP-REF-SRC-001 | `imgres-(1).htm` | www.magnific.com | https://img.magnific.com/free-vector/ink-brush-stroke-grunge-banner-collection_1409-1495.jpg?semt=ais_hybrid&w=740&q=80 |
| PP-REF-SRC-002 | `imgres-(2).htm` | www.istockphoto.com | https://media.istockphoto.com/id/1403400653/vector/black-and-red-grunge-designs.jpg?s=612x612&w=0&k=20&c=luTbU-YG5Fd3V1zQpO-zo0WV2NTrXjW9gc7GZnPu_Dc= |
| PP-REF-SRC-003 | `imgres.htm` | www.pinterest.com | https://i.pinimg.com/474x/48/fe/50/48fe50216f2fb2a93204b51cfb8c299f.jpg |

The pointed-to images were **not** downloaded into the canon. Two of the sites (iStock, Magnific/Freepik) sell licences; the third is a Pinterest pin whose origin is unknown.

## If you want to use one for real
Buy or obtain a licence from the rights holder, record it in the sidecar (`license`, `source.url`, `source.creator`, licence id), move the file into `30_ASSETS` with a new id, and log the decision in the register.
